description: The plot, titled "Whisper fine-tunning, type = tiny," illustrates the relationship between the word error rate (WER) and the training epoch for five different fine-tuning configurations. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with numeric tick markers spaced at an interval of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and utilizes a linear scale with visible values ranging from 30 to 70, marked at an interval of 10. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" configuration is represented by a solid grey line with circle markers, showing a steady decline from an initial WER of approximately 68.8 at epoch 0 down to roughly 36.2 at epoch 6. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" configuration is depicted as a solid grey line with square markers, starting at a WER of roughly 59.8 at epoch 0 and decreasing continuously to end at approximately 32.2 at epoch 6. The "tiny int4" configuration is shown as a dashed grey line with circle markers; it starts at approximately 68.8 at epoch 0, declines to around 39.4 at epoch 5, and slightly increases to roughly 40.1 at epoch 6. The "tiny int8" configuration appears as a dashed grey line with square markers, beginning with a WER of about 59.8 at epoch 0, dropping to roughly 46.8 at epoch 1, and continuing a gradual decline to end at approximately 37.0 at epoch 6. Finally, the "tiny full" configuration is indicated by a dotted grey line with upward-pointing triangle markers, exhibiting a steady, gradual decline from an initial value of approximately 28.9 at epoch 0 to roughly 22.9 by epoch 6.
